title: Billing Office Posting Rule — Capped Rental Months of Mobility Equipment
content:
# Capped Rental Month Billing — Mobility Equipment

**Rule.** Mobility Equipment rental months are billed on the anniversary of the rental period start date (the class's rental month anchor): the same day of each later calendar month, falling back to the last day of a shorter month; after a resumption the next month starts on the resumption date. Each month's number is the next ordinal after the months already paid in the current rental period. Months 1 to 3 carry modifier KH or KI and the covered class's rental fee for months 1 to 3; later months carry KJ and the covered class's rental fee for months from month 4 on. The allowed amount is the covered class's fee multiplied by the coverage class's allowed percentage of the fee schedule and divided by 100, rounded to the cent half up. Months are never prorated, and no month whose first day falls in a suspension is billed. A rental month is billed only while the wheelchair record is rental active.

## Months already paid in the current rental period

The paid months counted are the paid rental months of the chair under the coverage the wheelchair record names, whose first day of service is on or after the rental period start date, up to the day of handling, less every paid month the payer has since taken back.

## Status gate

The status is read from the system record of this wheelchair record before the month is billed: only rental active allows a rental month to be billed.

## Month, modifier and fee

| Month number | Modifier | Fee used |
|---|---|---|
| 1, 2, 3 | KH or KI | covered class's rental fee for months 1 to 3 |
| 4 and later | KJ | covered class's rental fee for months from month 4 on |

## Worked examples (hypothetical allowed percentage of 80)

- Covered class Lightweight Manual Wheelchair (K0003), month 2: 61.22 multiplied by 80 and divided by 100 is 48.976, rounded half up to 48.98.
- Same class, month 5: 45.92 multiplied by 80 and divided by 100 is 36.736, rounded half up to 36.74.

## Anniversary dates (hypothetical)

A rental period starting on 31 January has its next months starting on the last day of February (the shorter month), then 31 March, 30 April and 31 May. A rental period starting on 15 June has months starting 15 July, 15 August and so on. If a suspension covered 15 August, no month starting 15 August is billed; after a resumption the next month starts on the resumption date.
